shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -c "sed -n '1,260p' server.js && printf '\\n--- app.js ---\\n' && sed -n '1,300p' public/app.js && printf '\\n--- styles lines ---\\n' && wc -l public/styles.css"
/bin/bash -c "cat package.json && printf '\\n--- package-lock diff ---\\n' && git diff -- package-lock.json | head -100 && printf '\\n--- current diff stat ---\\n' && git diff --stat"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: data/books.json
@@
-[
-  {
-    \"id\": \"f5c8ad4b-74b4-4e97-98ba-ec3d0b7df313\",
-    \"title\": \"The Test Book\",
-    \"author\": \"A. Reader\",
-    \"notes\": \"A saved note.\",
-    \"status\": \"finished\",
-    \"createdAt\": \"2026-09-22T20:22:24.884Z\",
-    \"finishedAt\": \"2026-09-22T20:22:24.893Z\"
-  }
-]
+[]
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build && git diff -- package.json && git status --short && nl -ba server.js | sed -n '1,220p' && nl -ba public/app.js | sed -n '1,80p' && nl -ba public/styles.css | sed -n '1,50p'"

/bin/bash -c "apply_patch <<'PATCH'
*** Begin Patch
*** Update File: public/styles.css
@@
-@import url(\"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=DM+Serif+Display&display=swap\");
-
 :root {
*** End Patch
PATCH
npm run build && git diff --check && printf '\\n--- final data ---\\n' && cat data/books.json && printf '\\n--- key references ---\\n' && rg -n 'dataFile|function updateBooks|async function handleApi|function homeMarkup|function detailMarkup|async function copyBookLink|@media' server.js public/app.js public/styles.css && printf '\\n--- status ---\\n' && git status --short"
